content.content: 1. Necessity: the refusal needs the two verbs' selector-less scope for the argument surfaces it covers — without either, refusing an argument is motiveless. Fail if an edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts a prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Undo's and redo's argument surfaces are where the elaboration meets the two verbs; the gate keeps the use sound without testing refusal itself.
